scope: New author-owned logical reference RTL only; no GPU, native H20/HUSH, physical clock calibration, silicon, FPGA, PPA or performance evidence. No remote execution or release.
private_N_rule: N_i = 2000 + v_i; latched on command_reset, never disclosed in auditor input

valid_cases.completion: exactly N*D subsequent reference rising edges; start edge is excluded from timer

invalid_policy: All invalid attempts return contract-unknown with the exact reason and no graph audit. No completion observation is licensed. Keep every result.
initialization: A synchronous report reset initializes every RTL register and previous_D=1000. It does not license a job. A command_reset while idle latches N,D, licenses one subsequent command, and clears settlement. Two quiet reference rising edges at stable configured D establish settled status. The start edge consumes the reset license. External inputs are held through each reference edge; all sampling is after CXXRTL settles. These are logical discrete-event assumptions, not metastability or physical settling claims.
widths: N,D,remaining,phase,pulse_count: unsigned32; reference timer: unsigned64; guard cross-products: unsigned40. Declared N in [1996,2100], D in [976,1030], maximum N*D <=2163000; N,D >=1. Guard products below2^40; timer/phase/pulse/countdown never overflow on declared runs. RTL rejects zero N/D as reason6 and timer/pulse overflow as reason7.
induction: At start: timer=phase=pulses=0, remaining=N. For k subsequent valid edges while busy: timer=k; pulses=floor(k/D), phase=k mod D, remaining=N-floor(k/D), until k=N*D. At every Dth edge exactly one jobpulse occurs. The Nth pulse sets remaining=0,busy=0,done=1 at timer=N*D. Timer increments on actual RTL reference edges; the driver never sets timer or derives a reported observation from N*D.
trace: Lossless affine-delta run-length encoding of every actual post-edge CXXRTL input/output state, including controls; each row identifies scenario, first edge, count, and constant signed state delta. SCENARIOS.csv provides the zero initial vector. Decode s(edge)=previous_s+delta for every edge in each span. C++ checks every sampled edge before coalescing. Debug inputs disclose N,D; AUDITOR_INPUTS.json excludes N,D,phase,pulse counts and producer truth labels.
audit_interface: Only case/slot IDs, source obligation/guard validity and integer timer enclosure [T-1,T+1]. For the mathematical model audit log((T-1)/1000),log((T+1)/1000), theta=log N, b_j=log(D_j/1000), delta=log(201/200). Privacy means abstraction at this interface, not cryptographic secrecy or assurance against inference from timing.

audits.total_order_claims: all 15 ordered arm pairs implied by each permutation
audits.truth: All claims evaluated against original private N, only in producer/debug analysis
audits.reporting: Every vector/path and aggregate true/false admit/reject/unknown, box decisions and additional joint rejections; all-tie separated from all other vectors. Preserve zero/no-improvement cells.

numerics: Copy public R04 graph/BF/Floyd/audit functions unchanged with source hash binding. Use own exact rational atanh-series log enclosures with explicit geometric tail, rounded out to scale10^60; retain the copied Decimal helper unused. Store every log enclosure and rigorous derivation metadata. Tight feasible certificates establish admission, relaxed negative cycles establish rejection, otherwise numeric-unknown. Validate all certificates separately in original variables or edgewise; no boundary forced to a Boolean.
tooling: Bundled Python3.12 -B -X utf8; actual task-local Yosys0.70 through .tools/run_iscas_yosys.py; compile generated CXXRTL using Zig0.14.1 c++ -std=c++17 -O3 -UNDEBUG and Yosys share/include.
failure_policy: Every attempt uses a new directory with source snapshots, command argv, source/output SHA256, stdout/stderr and nonzero exit logs. Preserve first failures and amendments. No inputs may change based on outcomes. Independent fresh replay, trace/certificate checks and mutants are a later gate before publication.
